newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria real GDP grew 3.9 percent in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Syria real GDP grew 3.9 percent in 1995.

text.p: Syria's real gross domestic product grew 3.9 percent in 1995, according to officials quoting the director of the central statistics office.
In constant prices GDP totalled 204.5 billion Syrian pounds ($4.09 billion) in 1995 compared with 196.8 billion in 1994,
In current prices GDP was 945 billion pounds in 1995 compared with 851.7 billion in 1994.
The black market price for a U.S. dollar is 50 Syrian pounds. The government uses several exchange rates for its calculations -- 42, 23 and 11 pounds to the dollar.
